items.text: Ideogram launched Ad Resizer, converting one uploaded design into campaign-ready assets for social, video and connected-TV placements.
items.text_zh: Ideogram 推出 Ad Resizer，可将一份上传的设计转换成适配社交媒体、视频和联网电视广告位的整套素材。

items.text: Runway added Seedance 2.5, supporting 50 character references and music-synchronized video clips lasting up to 30 seconds.
items.text_zh: Runway 上线 Seedance 2.5，支持最多 50 个角色参考，并可生成最长 30 秒、与音乐同步的视频片段。

items.text: Luma introduced Scenes, letting creators refine individual scenes without regenerating an entire AI-produced advertisement.
items.text_zh: Luma 推出 Scenes，创作者可以单独调整某个场景，无需重新生成整支 AI 广告。

items.text: Krea launched a Slack beta combining multiple generative models with an agent that adapts to a creative team’s preferences.
items.text_zh: Krea 推出 Slack 测试版，将多款生成模型与能够适应创意团队偏好的智能体结合起来。

items.text: Replit expanded its MCP beta so external agents can create, load, search and publish Replit applications directly.
items.text_zh: Replit 扩展 MCP 测试版，外部智能体现在可以直接创建、载入、搜索并发布 Replit 应用。

items.text: Unsloth released an open-source desktop application for running and training models locally across macOS, Windows and Linux.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 发布开源桌面应用，支持在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 设备上本地运行及训练模型。

items.text: ElectricSQL, creator of browser-embeddable Postgres engine PGlite, is joining Databricks to bring WASM Postgres into AI-agent sandboxes.
items.text_zh: 浏览器内嵌式 Postgres 引擎 PGlite 的开发商 ElectricSQL 将加入 Databricks，把 WASM Postgres 引入 AI 智能体沙箱。

items.text: LlamaIndex introduced ExtractBench, a benchmark for measuring information extraction from complex enterprise documents.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 推出 ExtractBench，用于衡量模型从复杂企业文档中提取信息的能力。

items.text: Artificial Analysis found GPT-5.5 xhigh led its new AnalystAgent benchmark in single-run reliability with a 66% pass rate.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 的新 AnalystAgent 基准显示，GPT-5.5 xhigh 以 66% 的单次运行通过率取得最高可靠性。

items.text: Google demonstrated AMIE conducting real-time audio-visual clinical consultations in a first-of-its-kind research study.
items.text_zh: 谷歌在一项首创研究中展示了 AMIE 实时开展音视频临床问诊的能力。

items.text: General Catalyst led a $1.1 billion funding round for River AI, a startup founded only two months earlier.
items.text_zh: General Catalyst 领投 River AI 的 11 亿美元融资，而这家 AI 初创公司成立仅两个月。

items.text: OpenAI released a Linux preview of its ChatGPT desktop app, bringing ChatGPT Work and Codex to several major distributions.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Linux 桌面应用预览版，将 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 带到多个主流发行版。

items.text: Spotify will label AI Persona artist profiles and exclude their tracks from algorithmic recommendations, while leaving them searchable.
items.text_zh: Spotify 将标记“AI Persona”艺人主页，并把其音乐排除在算法推荐之外，但用户仍可主动搜索。

items.text: Manus said it will resume operating independently and announced transition measures required by regulations in specified regions.
items.text_zh: Manus 宣布将恢复独立运营，并将依据特定地区的监管要求实施相应过渡措施。

items.text: Mistral introduced EU data processing and paid priority access, although regional routing excludes several features and priority availability is not guaranteed.
items.text_zh: Mistral 推出欧盟境内数据处理和付费优先访问服务，但区域路由不覆盖部分功能，优先可用性也不作保证。

items.text: Tencent Hunyuan presented research evaluating whether self-modifying AI agents genuinely improve, targeting more reliable measurement of self-evolution.
items.text_zh: 腾讯混元发布研究，评估能够修改自身的 AI 智能体是否真正获得改进，以提高自进化效果衡量的可靠性。

items.text: Xiaomi's MiLM Plus introduced PROVE, combining two perception-aligned object-removal metrics with a real-world video benchmark.
items.text_zh: 小米 MiLM Plus 推出 PROVE，将两项符合人类感知的视频物体移除指标与真实世界视频基准结合起来。

items.text: Qwen made its Qwen-Image-3.0 image generator available for testing through OpenArt.
items.text_zh: Qwen 已将其 Qwen-Image-3.0 图像生成模型接入 OpenArt，供用户在线试用。

items.text: Qwen said Qwen3.8-Max climbed from 22nd to fourth place on the Legal Research Bench leaderboard.
items.text_zh: Qwen 表示，Qwen3.8-Max 在 Legal Research Bench 法律研究排行榜上由第 22 名升至第 4 名。

items.text: Ollama can now serve as a local model provider for GitHub Copilot inside JetBrains development environments.
items.text_zh: Ollama 现在可在 JetBrains 开发环境中充当 GitHub Copilot 的本地模型提供方。

items.text: AEROBAT automated agent-behavior research, generating 79 hypotheses and executing 23,512 simulation rounds across 12 target behaviors.
items.text_zh: AEROBAT 自动完成智能体行为研究流程，围绕 12 种目标行为生成 79 项假设，并执行了 23,512 轮模拟。

items.text: MESA improved long-horizon agent-memory performance by 8.5% while using 41% fewer evidence tokens than an all-structure approach.
items.text_zh: MESA 通过按任务选择多种记忆结构，使长程智能体记忆性能提升 8.5%，同时比全结构方案少用 41% 的证据令牌。

items.text: FACT trains world-action models on failed actions, reducing success-biased future hallucinations and improving simulated and real-world bimanual manipulation.
items.text_zh: FACT 利用失败动作训练世界—动作模型，减少偏向成功结果的未来幻觉，并改善仿真及真实双臂操作表现。

items.text: MarkNull reduced AI-image watermark bit accuracy to 53.14% without perceptible degradation and also compromised Google's SynthID-Image.
items.text_zh: MarkNull 在没有可感知画质损失的情况下，将 AI 图像水印比特准确率降至 53.14%，并成功攻破 Google SynthID-Image。

items.text: A deterministic streaming guardrail withheld every chunk completing predefined dangerous lexical pairs, but researchers stressed its coverage remains deliberately narrow.
items.text_zh: 一种确定性流式防护机制成功拦截所有补全预设危险词对的文本块，但研究者强调其覆盖范围刻意保持狭窄。

items.text: Researchers catalogued LLM-mediated variants of eight classic web attacks, finding vulnerability depends on both application architecture and model behavior.
items.text_zh: 研究者归纳了八类由大模型介导的传统网络攻击，发现风险同时取决于应用架构和模型行为。

items.text: An empirical study examined when chain-of-thought improves reasoning and when sequential processing depth instead becomes a performance bottleneck.
items.text_zh: 一项实证研究分析了思维链何时能够改善推理，以及串行处理深度何时反而成为性能瓶颈。

items.text: Researchers proposed closed-loop LLM copilots that combine agricultural sensor data, domain knowledge and feedback-driven recommendations for digital farming.
items.text_zh: 研究者提出闭环农业大模型助手，结合传感器数据、领域知识和反馈驱动的建议服务数字农业。
